Subject: PrivInfra CI test matrix + rollforward/rollback plan (Archer POC)

Team — kicking off the runbook review for the Archer POC private deployment. Attached is an initial CI test matrix (ci-test-matrix-v1.csv) and a short checklist I sketched for the rollforward/rollback windows.

High level goals:
- Validate Terraform + Helm changes via gated CI (unit -> integ -> smoke -> canary).
- Confirm network topology checks (SNAT, BGP health, private DNS).
- Define an automated rollback signal and manual abort hooks.

Please review the matrix for coverage gaps (especially Terraform modules: vpc, subnet, firewall, and node pools). Rishi — can you draft the rollback script that rips out the Helm release and reverts TF state? Grace — pls confirm canary test criteria and acceptable latency/throughput deltas for the smoke window. Laura — I want procurement/ops checklist items included before we hand to Archer (SOCs, audit records).

Attached: ci-test-matrix-v1.csv

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.ai]

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PrivInfra CI test matrix + rollforward/rollback plan (Archer POC)

Thanks Jordan — read through csv quickly. A few notes inline and high-level items: 

- Canary gating: require 2 sequential successful canary runs (15m apart) with no >3% 99th-ms latency regression and no token-loss errors.
- Add deterministic traffic replay for canary using archived prompt set (see Confluence link).
- Terraform: add a preflight plan checkpoint that validates module inputs (CIDR overlap, route table attachments) — mark these as blockers for integrate stage.
- Helm: include post-install readiness probe that checks KV cache warmup (we've seen cold-start thrash in smaller node pools).

Minor: the matrix currently lists only basic network checks; add SNAT mapping inventory and control-plane reachability checks (IAM/port 443 to control plane endpoints).

I can slot time tomorrow to work through the test matrix and update the canary acceptance criteria.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Jordan / Grace — I pushed an initial rollback/rollforward playbook (rollforward-playbook.md) and a draft rollback script to the PR linked below. Key points:

- Rollforward: automated Helm release patch + canary traffic routing back to previous release (uses feature-flagged routing in the gateway).
- Rollback: terraform rollback is non-trivial if state drift occurs; plan is to snapshot the state (terraform state pull) and run targeted 'terraform apply -target' to reconstruct previous resources.
- Safety: abort if control-plane metrics (API 5xx or queue length) exceed thresholds for >5m.

I opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/priv-deploy/pull/214 with the playbook and scripts. Please review the script comments (esp. the state snapshot cadence).

Attachments: rollforward-playbook.md

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Staff Engineer, Inference Infra

- Can you include a baseline BGP session health check (peer up, route counts, and prefix stability) in the smoke test?
- We'll share a short topology PDF for the POC (attached). We can approve the rollforward windows if those two checks are in place.

We prefer the canary window to be in a UTC-friendly slot: Tue/Wed 02:00–04:00 UTC. Let me know if that conflicts with your CI windows.
